preconditions.description: Number of vertices and edges within specified bounds.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= ui <= n and 1 <= vi <= n and 0 <= ti <= 10**18 and ui != vi for ui, vi, ti in edges)
preconditions.description: Each edge has valid vertices and non-negative integer weight.

postconditions.expression: return_value == sum(s for u, v, s in interesting_triples) % (10**9 + 7)
postconditions.description: The output is the sum of all interesting triple values modulo 10^9 + 7.
